`class BlurNodeEffect`<br/>
**Extends:** [`NodeEffect<Node>`](/reference/effects/nodeeffect/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.node.effect.impl` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [BlurNodeEffect.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/node/effect/impl/BlurNodeEffect.java)

Blurs what a node draws with a horizontal then a vertical Gaussian pass.

![The placeholder image, blurred](/captures/catalog-effects-blurnodeeffect.webp)

## Description

It blurs the pixels of the node, and with the `CHILDREN` scope those of its children too; it never blurs what lies behind the node.
Its priority is `150`: it blurs the result of a rounded or circle pass, and a border drawn after it stays sharp.
